scope: The complete Secs2Date and Date2Secs procedures.

span.boundary_evidence: Secs2Date begins at 0x417052 after the Package Manager dispatch stubs. The final Date2Secs RTS ends at 0x41712c.

changes: Copied the complete original body from its File SexyDate.TEXT header through END without changing any instructions, labels, or comments.
Omitted the later EASE archive wrapper. Preserved Jerome T. Coonen's attribution and the original July 1983 date.
Added a reconstruction note about two original comment errors. The 68000 DIVU divisor limit is 65535; AND #3 computes a remainder modulo four. The original comment text remains unchanged.

verification.method: Translate the source syntax, expand its macro definitions, assemble for the 68000, link at the ROM address, and compare every emitted byte.
limitations: Byte equality establishes the complete emitted span. It cannot establish which archive header accompanied the original Mac Plus source.
The calendar comments also start November at March-relative day 244, overlapping October. That table entry is prose; the emitted conversion code remains unchanged.
